edit.description: Split the per-entry leg of tip verify off the shared checkTipMoved per spec/loop.md 'Tip verify' Per-entry leg bullet: ancestry check, whole-span gate+cherry-pick, refusal names both shas and adds a dropped-work MergeOutcome. Singleton leg's parent-equality check is unchanged.
Add an ancestry-check helper (merge-base --is-ancestor) the per-entry leg's check consumes.

Revise the test at :4802 (ancestor multi-commit case currently asserts revert — must flip to ship) and the :4958 'singleton/fanout agreement' describe (checks now diverge by leg); add non-ancestor refusal + dropped-work verdict coverage.

summary: Per-entry tip verify: ancestry replaces parent-equality; N-commit spans ship whole; non-descent refusal names both shas + dropped-work merge-outcome fact.

per.section: Tip verify — commit only onto the tip the tick started on

tests: fanout entry worktree with two commits both descending from the recorded base ships the whole span (gates run, cherry-pick lands, entry ships) instead of reverting as tip-moved
fanout entry worktree rewritten to a commit not descending from the recorded base refuses tip-verify, naming both the recorded base and observed HEAD sha in the log line and persisted record
a per-entry tip-verify refusal lands its own dropped-work merge-outcome fact in the tick verdict, distinguishable from a parked/no-op entry
singleton leg's parent-equality full-span revert is unchanged by the split
acceptance: pnpm tsc && pnpm test green; new/updated Dispatcher tests assert the ancestor case ships and the non-ancestor case refuses naming both shas with a dropped-work merge-outcome.
notes: tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:4802 currently asserts the ancestor case reverts (pre-fix bug, per inbox 2026-08-05 field report) — must flip to ship. :4958 'singleton/fanout agreement' asserts one shared check — must split by leg. buildTipMoved(preHead, parent) at :2442 records the parent, not postHead — the per-entry leg needs the true observed HEAD.
